reader.requirement: For a relative file with RECORD IS VARYING, a WRITE whose record length (the DEPENDING ON data-name-1 value, else the record's current size, §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10) is below integer-2 or above integer-3 must be unsuccessful: nothing written, record area unaffected, I-O status 44 (a logic error, not the invalid key condition).
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior|CobolVersion in FileConnector.Stored, KeyedConnector.RecordRulesFailure, SequentialIoEmitter.VaryingLengthArg: none; the bound check is the same at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses are sequential-organization REWRITE and WRITE ADVANCING; a relative file, DEPENDING ON below/above/at the bounds and an ODO record are not exercised

probes.expected: RLEN 3, 11, 0 -> 44, USE runs, no INVALID KEY, nothing written (slots 1, 2, 5 read 23), record area and RLEN unchanged; RLEN 4 and 10 (the bounds) succeed with those lengths; an ODO record without DEPENDING writes at its current size

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR8  (4.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5d.1

reader.notes: RelativeConnector.Write asks RecordRulesFailure after the open-mode rule and before any key rule, so a too-short record to an occupied slot answers 44, not 22. Without DEPENDING ON, §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2 keeps every described record inside the bounds, so the size check is reachable only through data-name-1, which the probe drives.

refuter.evidence: rvar.cob at --std 85: RECORD IS VARYING FROM 5 TO 11 with no DEPENDING ON and a record of OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON (minimum 3 bytes) is refused at compile time, COBOL2010 citing §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2, so without data-name-1 no record can fall outside the bounds and the run-time check is reachable only through DEPENDING ON, which the reader drove (44 below, above and at 0; 00 at both bounds). rsra.cob: an ODO record in a VARYING 3 TO 12 file written at RLEN 7 and 3 -> 00 and read back at those lengths. The DialectBehavior RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (2002) keeps the 44 check off Format 3 at 85, which GR8 does not reach. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR8 'the WRITE operation does not take place'; OK §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2.
